Traveler questions on a smooth middle
Staff will learn what is expected

Companion Animal Travel Desk Service Standards

This section gives staff a calm, consistent way to guide travelers with companion animals and keep service steady at Aurelia Skyways.

Greet each traveler in a warm, even tone, and listen closely before giving next steps. Keep the exchange simple, accurate, and respectful, and avoid slang or rushed phrasing. When a traveler shares details about a pet, confirm the travel plan, check the required records, and note any service change in the desk ledger right away. If the traveler is unsure, explain the process in plain words and stay patient while they review their documents.

For birds, follow the approved age rule before accepting the booking. For larger dogs, check the crate against the size limit before you clear the trip. <<FACT F077>> Keep the discussion focused on readiness, comfort, and safety, and do not promise approval until every requirement is met.

If the crate, carrier, or paperwork does not fit policy, say so clearly and offer the correct next step without blame. Use the same careful approach whether the traveler is a frequent flyer or new to the desk, and keep all updates in the record so the team can continue smoothly. Prompt service, respectful language, and clean notes help the whole desk work better.

If anything is unclear, contact the senior coordinator or the current duty supervisor for guidance.
